senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. חָסַם II; v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v.) a glittering substance; amber or galena (?).
units: Ḥag. 13ᵃ עד הח׳ including the verse in which ḥashmal appears (Ez. I, 27).
Ib. היה מבין בח׳ was speculating on the meaning of ḥashmal; ויצאה אש מח׳ and fire came out of the ḥashmal.
Ib., sq. מהו ח̇ש̇מ̇ל̇ ח̇יות אש̇ מְמַ֗לְּ֗לוֹת Ḥayoth (v. חַיָּה) speaking fire; v. חָשָׁה.
